schema.description: One UTC hour of one phone's positions, as OwnTracks reported them in HTTP mode, through the anam_owntracks importer (source owntracks). Each point is one fix: the coordinates, accuracy and context the phone wrote, never snapped, smoothed or joined to a place. The hour is the fix time's hour (the phone's tst), not when the fix was received, so a phone that was offline fills in its hours when it reconnects, and a resend replaces an hour whole. OwnTracks can report one fix as several messages with the same tst (a manual publish and a ping); they are one point here, with every trigger kept. Places and stays are not here: they would be derived from these.

id.description: "loc:", the device and the hour. The identity: one facet per phone per hour.

hour.description: The UTC hour the points fall in, at its start. The fact time.

device.description: The phone, as OwnTracks names it in its X-Limit-D header (its Device Id setting), which the receiver authenticates with the credentials.

points.description: The hour's fixes, oldest first, one per fix time.

t.description: tst, the fix time the phone wrote, as a UTC instant.

lat.description: lat: latitude in degrees, WGS-84, as written.

lon.description: lon: longitude in degrees, WGS-84, as written.

alt.description: alt: altitude in metres above sea level.

vac.description: vac: vertical accuracy of alt in metres.

cog.description: cog: course over ground in degrees.

batt.description: batt: the phone's battery level in percent.

bs.description: bs: battery status: 0 unknown, 1 unplugged, 2 charging, 3 full.

conn.description: conn: the phone's connectivity: w WiFi, m mobile data, o offline.

ssid.description: SSID: the WiFi network the phone was on.

bssid.description: BSSID: the WiFi access point the phone was on.

inregions.description: inregions: the phone's own regions the fix was inside, by the names set on the phone.

monitoring.description: m: the monitoring mode the phone was in: -1 quiet, 0 manual, 1 significant changes, 2 move.

location_source.description: source: the Android location provider that made the fix, e.g. fused, gps, network.

triggers.description: t: why the phone reported the fix, every distinct reason across its messages in the order received: p ping, u manual publish, c circular region, C region, r report requested, t timer, v frequent locations.

tid.description: tid: the tracker id the phone shows, a short label set on the phone.
